systems.system: Mauritius National Identity Scheme (MNIS) / Mauritius National Identity Card system (MNIC 3.0)
systems.platform: built with the Singapore Cooperation Enterprise; revamp agreed by Cabinet on 2021-02-19
systems.owner: Prime Minister's Office; steering committee chaired by the Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation
systems.tiers: national; issued at Identity Card Centres; first phase of the new card launched 2024-02-26

systems.system: Central database kept by the Registrar of Civil Status under section 3 of the National Identity Card Act, at the Government Online Centre (Mauritius National Identity Card Database)
systems.tiers: central; fingerprint images and minutiae removed in 2015 after the Supreme Court ruling
citizen app, planned as the second phase of the new card under the 2024 regulations

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation
systems.tiers: national two-factor authentication for government e-services

note: A policy brief on the identity card and Mobile ID: every system it describes is of the identity class, and it says nothing on how or where births and deaths are registered.
